emma_cs: Heads-up  NovaThera overloaded the APAC edge during their live POC. Theyre asking for a short-term allowlist + temporary QPS increase for demo hosts (203.119.0.0/25). Renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks  want to avoid a failed demo. Can ops/infra assist?
kyle_ops: We can support. Which APAC region do they want pinned?
hyun_net: They requested seoul (ap-northeast-2). Also supplied two egress IPs: 203.119.0.22 and 203.119.0.23  prefer those whitelisted explicitly.
emma_cs: Customer note pasted: "bursting to ~380 rps during session; please lift soft qps to 2600 for the demo window and provide a short cost summary afterwards."
kyle_ops: Proposed plan: soft QPS=2600, hard QPS=3600, autorevoke after 24h, customer wants 12h pre-revoke notice. Need eng-infra approval for region pin + proxy ACL.
hyun_net: Minimal checklist for eng-infra: 1) add CIDR 203.119.0.0/25 to tenant allowlist 2) add specific egress IPs 203.119.0.22/32 and 203.119.0.23/32 to ACL 3) set tenant.novathera soft=2600 hard=3600 4) schedule autorevoke @24h 5) route peering -> ap-northeast-2 6) smoke test from 203.119.0.22
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: draft change scheduled: 2026-02-14T03:30:00Z  status: pending-approval. Change summary: allowlist 203.119.0.0/25 + egress IPs, soft qps=2600, hard=3600, autorevoke=24h, region pin ap-northeast-2.
parul_renewals: Flagging renewals team  demo outcome = high impact on renewal. Please capture post-demo feedback and any qualitative points.
cost-bot: cost-bot: acknowledged. Will calculate estimated token-cost delta for requested window and produce a short summary after demo.
hyun_net: Test curl to validate allowlist once applied:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"X-Forwarded-For: 203.119.0.22\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expected: 200
kyle_ops: Created ENGOPS-6999 and pinged @eng-infra: "novathera: ap-northeast-2 temp allowlist + qps bump" https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-6999
kyle_ops: Rollback criteria: sustained p50 latency > 400ms OR error rate > 1% over a 2m window -> immediate revert and notify CS + customer. Will collect traces for the window.
emma_cs: Customer asked for a one-paragraph confirmation email after changes and the 12h pre-revoke notice. Who can own the confirmation?
hyun_net: I can draft the confirmation email and paste it here for review.
parul_renewals: Ill add a renewal-playbook entry and tag the account in CRM with demo outcome.
kyle_ops: Will post status updates in this thread when infra approves and after the smoke test. If approvals block the window, we escalate to eng-infra pager. :rocket:
